meta.source: Talyvor brand board, 4 Oct 2026, plus the talyvor-suite token file (packages/ui/src/tokens.ts)

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Obsidian in dark, Frost-white in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, navigation, sidebars, the app shell.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards and menus that sit on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, table rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, secondary button outline, focus-adjacent rules.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines, on canvas, surface and raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions, on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Spaced-caps eyebrows, taglines and section labels.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, active navigation, the teal rule. Light uses the deep teal so text stays above 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active pills, highlight backgrounds.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Settled payments, passing checks, money in.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Held funds, pending approvals, warnings.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Refused calls, failed payments, destructive actions.

tokens.name: brand-obsidian
tokens.usage: Board colour Obsidian. Primary background of every dark brand surface.

tokens.name: brand-surface
tokens.usage: Board colour Surface. Panels and navigation.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Board colour Teal. The accent: the arrowhead, the rule, one call to action. Never more than about 5% of a layout.

tokens.name: brand-frost
tokens.usage: Board colour Frost. Text on dark, light backgrounds.

tokens.name: brand-muted
tokens.usage: Board colour Muted. Secondary text.

tokens.name: brand-mist
tokens.usage: The tagline colour under the wordmark on dark.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: The wordmark on dark.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and tight rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The app gutter; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups; the teal rule is 32px long.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero padding on the site.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon squircle (Apple ratio).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills.
